'''Threat monitors''' were a system of [[electroreceptor]]s, [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], and [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensors]] that were installed in [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to warn the wearer of nearby threats. Models of threat scanner were produced by [[Galactic Electronics]] and [[Atlas Corp]] and sold for 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="LoNH" />
